test_title: RRB NTPC - UG 2025 (CBT 1) Foundational Full Test - 01
subject: general
question: Which of the following statement is wrong?

options.text: Carnivores like tiger have a short intestine in length.
The small intestine is the longest part of the alimentary canal.
The outer layer of the small intestine has many protruding finger-like protrusions, called villi.
The small intestine is the site of the complete digestion of carbohydrates, proteins and fats.

solution:
The correct answer is __**The outer layer of the small intestine has many protruding finger-like protrusions, called villi**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Small, finger-like projections inside the small intestine **that extend into the small intestine lumen are known as** intestinal villi.**
 
• In humans, each villus is around 0.5–1.6 mm long and has several microvilli extending from its epithelium's enterocytes, which together form the striated or brush border.
 
• The intestines of predatory animals such as tigers and lions are expected to be 3-7 feet long.
 
• Protein digestion is easier than complex carbohydrate digestion, according to physiology.
 
• **The small intestine, **which is around 10 feet long (about 3 metres) in a living person and twice as long in a cadaver due to loss of muscular tone, is the longest section of the digestive system or alimentary canal.
 
• The small intestine in the human body is where carbohydrates, proteins, and lipids are completely digested.
